title: 10-Day Fills
description: Welcome to 10-Day Fills! In this 10-day challenge, Domino will show you four easy drum fills that you can start playing right now. By the end of the series, you will be playing all of these fills, along with a full song!

title: 30-Day Drummer
description: 30-Day Drummer: Season 3 is the next evolution on learning how to play drums – where you learn by actually playing the drums. By focusing on timing & coordination, you’ll build your skills over thirty days following daily guided workouts with your instructor, Domino Santantonio.

title: 30-Day Chops
description: Learn to explode creatively around the drums. 30-Day Chops will teach you the fundamentals of drum chops through consistent daily practice. By the end of the month, you'll have a new arsenal of chops to help you explode in 1, 2, and 4 bar patterns anytime the song calls for it.
